# meraki_network_firmware_upgrades_staged_stage (Data Source)

This data source can read the `Network Firmware Upgrades Staged Stage` configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "meraki_network_firmware_upgrades_staged_stage" "example" {
  network_id = "L_123456"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) Network ID

### Read-Only

- `_json` (Attributes List) Array of Staged Upgrade Groups (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--_json))
- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--_json"></a>
### Nested Schema for `_json`

Read-Only:

- `group_id` (String) ID of the Staged Upgrade Group
